text:
carla: TeraSys reported that after a firmware rollout some devices are reporting sku_alias values (e.g. 'edge-v2-legacy') that used to map to sku A but now should map to sku B. Marketplace ingested events and entitlements attached to the old sku -> mismatch on customer feature flags. Need mitigation + recon.
owen: sounds like sku alias rotation without a canonical id. Do we have alias->sku history stored? I think not consistently.
mira: Billing shows customers missing access to billed features and some ledgers undercounted by ~9k token-units for 2025-09-14. We need a safe way to reassign entitlements and settle any delta.
syl: short ops mitigation: stop automatic entitlement updates for events with alias fields until we validate mapping. Can we apply a hold tag and notify partner webhook?
carla: partner wants auto-resolution when alias maps 1:1 to current sku in our catalog, but they also want a deprecation window for old aliases (30 days) to avoid surprises.
owen: propose rules: 1) if alias resolves to current sku and alias last_seen < 30d -> auto-apply entitlement; 2) if alias resolves but last_seen >= 30d -> provisional entitlement + audit tag; 3) ambiguous alias -> hold + notify. I'll add a small alias-history table and a fast lookup service.
mira: finance policy: auto-apply -> charge as normal; provisional -> charge zero and flag for off-cycle settle when partner confirms mapping; ambiguous -> no charge until resolved. Need partner-facing wording.
carla: partner webhook sample they asked for (for auto-resolve notifications):
```
POST /partners/terasys/webhooks/sku-alias-resolution
{
  "event_id": "evt-20250914-01",
  "device_id": "ts-9988",
  "reported_alias": "edge-v2-legacy",
  "resolved_sku": "terasys-edge-v2",
  "resolution_mode": "auto_apply",
  "timestamp": "2025-09-14T18:02:00Z"
}
```
owen: quick SQL to find suspect events (14-day window):
```
SELECT partner_id, device_model, reported_alias, count(*) AS events, sum(tokens) AS total_tokens
FROM partner_usage_events
WHERE reported_alias IS NOT NULL
  AND (sku_id IS NULL OR sku_id != lookup_current_sku(reported_alias))
  AND received_at >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY partner_id, device_model, reported_alias
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
syl: ops: add metric `marketplace.alias.resolve_auto`, `marketplace.alias.provisional`, and an alert if provisional >1000 in 30m. Also add a ledger lease during the settle window to avoid double writes: `ledger.lock('alias-reconcile', ttl=600)`.
mira: reconciliation playbook: 1) run SQL to find batches, 2) enrich with alias-history lookup, 3) apply auto or provisional per rules, 4) generate off-cycle file for provisional cases, 5) post webhook to partner with details, 6) after partner confirmation, re-run settle and emit credit/charge adjustments.
carla: ownership: owen builds alias-history service and worker (ETA 48h to staging), syl adds alerts and ledger guard (ETA 24h), mira drafts finance note & partner comms (ETA 12h). I'll coordinate partner QA.
atlas-bot: Scheduled job 'alias-reconcile-staging' created: id ar-20250915-01, owner owen, runs staging 2025-09-15T02:30:00Z.
carla: thanks all 44d we'll review outputs after the staging run.
